pages.camera: Editorial briefing-table composition matching the published Weeks 7–9 Opening Drive: a perspective Commonwealth map, sealed Week 10 folio, established banners and meaningful scene props under warm lamps. OPENING DRIVE is the dominant department heading; Room Above Two Hundred is the story subheading. Full narration is integrated into two calm dark atmospheric reading zones, not replaced by captions.
pages.body: By Sunday night, the Commonwealth had learned that a number could become a weapon without anyone lifting a blade. Two teams had crossed two hundred. One sent a hamburger to a birthday party; another brought an army to a mountain gate. A centaur was chasing an outlaw through Highland mud. In the eastern ruins, a river quietly made a mockery of Red Leopards’ sandbags, while a second gust carried the same storm's reach to a court farther inland. Seven Deadly Chins found the one household that needed quiet and arrived with a jackhammer. Slob on my Dobb made a beer delivery through a swamp whose owner could no longer command the road. The front belonged to El Niño; the humiliations belonged to the men who chose them. With four regular-season games now remaining, the question was no longer simply who won. It was what each result would leave behind.
pages.headline: ROOM ABOVE TWO HUNDRED

pages.camera: Eye-level three-quarter institutional interior; opened door and map wall establish the wider world.
pages.body: There is a difference between being beaten and having to live with the evidence. A score is entered once. A birthday photograph is shown forever. A broken hoop stays broken until someone fixes it. The owner of a swamp still has to watch the next truck drive through. That is the Commonwealth we have spent seasons building, and it is why this league is more than six boxes on a scoreboard. But our stories do not outrank the standings. Nobody is going to Cancún by mathematical decree until the last route is closed. Nobody is healed because a reserve slot looks full. The numbers have settled, and six teams now share 6–4 records. The next week will ask each of us what we have left to field.
pages.headline: KEEP THE WHOLE LEAGUE IN VIEW

The old goal leaned over a pitch still carrying last week's damage. Red Leopards shifted another bag into place. The water went around it. In 2022, he had beaten El Niño twice and carried thirteen wins into the semifinal. It was not the strength of the old season he remembered now, but how little of it had mattered on the night it ended.
